## 【封装单元 1/4】
duration: 13
subject_definitions:
画面风格：手绘赛璐璐 · 粗描边 · 平涂色块 · 经典动画质感
<Subject 1> The young woman (20-25 years old) with a soft, round face, large dark-brown almond eyes, slender build, black medium-length hair falling to her shoulders with light bangs, wearing a white round-neck cotton short-sleeve top and light-blue cotton shorts, barefoot, sits on the edge of a bed. Her voice is soft, worried, gentle, with a slightly trembling tone at a moderate pace.
<Subject 2> A red spiky ball-shaped tiny monster (fist-sized, no gender) covered in short red spines with darker red tips, a small round light-orange belly patch, two short feet with three toes, two short arms with three-fingered round pads, large round pitch-black eyes, a wide W-shaped jagged mouth with tiny white fangs, no nose, two dark-red cheek patches, three upright dark-red spines on its head. Its voice is squeaky, shrill, chaotic, tiny, at a fast pace.
<Subject 3> The bedroom at night: a single bed on the right side of the frame, a light-wood bedside table next to the bed, a window with half-drawn curtains showing a dark blue night sky on the left wall, a white wardrobe on the far wall, a light-gray round rug on the floor, warm yellow lamplight from a bedside lamp, soft dim atmosphere.
<Subject 4> The skin surface micro-world: a vast light-pink skin surface with fine diamond grid texture, several raised red bumps of varying sizes, white flaky skin debris scattered, tiny floating blue light particles in the air, soft blue-white ambient light.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] In the warm lamplight of the bedroom <Subject 3>, <Subject 1> sits on the edge of the bed, her body slightly turned toward the left side of the frame, her right hand scratching her left forearm vigorously. Her face shows a pained frown, her lips part slightly as she mutters in a low, distressed voice: <d>[Chinese] 女主（痛苦，自言自语）："怎么又痒了……"</d>. The camera holds a medium shot from a front-side angle at eye level, fixed. Her left forearm is extended forward, displaying multiple red wheals, the skin reddening more with each scratch.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up from a top-down angle, fixed, hovering directly above the left forearm skin surface. One red bump on the skin surface is taut and shiny, suddenly splitting open with a small crack. From the crack, a tiny <Subject 2> pushes out, then rapidly divides like cell division: one becomes two, then four, then over a dozen small red monsters, all leaping and nibbling on the skin of <Subject 4>, making sharp squeaking sounds. <Subject 1> frowns, scratching forcefully but in vain, and cries out: <d>[Chinese] 女主（皱眉，用力抓挠，但无济于事）："走开！都走开！"</d>. The bumps on the skin are agitated, reddening further.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the camera cuts to a medium-close shot from a front-slightly-side angle, eye level, with slight handheld shake. <Subject 1> stands up anxiously beside the bed in <Subject 3>, her body leaning back, her hands scratching her shoulder and neck. Flocks of <Subject 2> monsters crawl up her arms, spreading to her shoulders and neck, jumping and nibbling, their squeaks dense and chaotic. Her face is twisted in pain, her eyes darting around as if seeking help, and she cries out desperately: <d>[Chinese] 女主（痛苦难忍，寻找帮助）："怎么办……"</d>. The warm lamplight sways with her movements, casting shifting shadows, while cold blue moonlight streams through the window.
overall_soundscape:
The soft hum of a bedside lamp, faint night breeze outside the window, the rustle of fabric as the woman moves, the continuous sharp squeaking of small monsters, the subtle sound of skin being nibbled and scratched, the quiet thud of tiny feet jumping on skin.
non_diegetic_music:
A low, tense ambient drone with a subtle heartbeat-like pulse, growing slightly more anxious during the monster outbreak, remaining subdued throughout.


## 【封装单元 2/4】
duration: 10
subject_definitions:
画面风格：手绘赛璐璐 · 粗描边 · 平涂色块 · 经典动画质感
<Subject 1> The young woman (20-25 years old) with a soft, round face, large dark-brown almond eyes, slender build, black medium-length hair falling to her shoulders with light bangs, wearing a white round-neck cotton short-sleeve top and light-blue cotton shorts, barefoot, sits on the edge of a bed. Her voice is soft, worried, gentle, with a slightly trembling tone at a moderate pace.
<Subject 3> The bedroom at night: a single bed on the right side of the frame, a light-wood bedside table next to the bed, a window with half-drawn curtains showing a dark blue night sky on the left wall, a white wardrobe on the far wall, a light-gray round rug on the floor, warm yellow lamplight from a bedside lamp, soft dim atmosphere.
<Subject 5> A tall heroic guardian figure (25-30 years old) with a square face, sharp jawline, light wheat-toned skin, wearing a white tube-shaped helmet with a light-blue spiral top and a vertical deep-blue front stripe, white-and-blue armor with a deep-blue diamond core on the chest, a short white cape, holding a compact gel applicator gun. His voice is deep, steady, reassuring, with a firm tone at a moderate pace.
<Subject 6> A white-and-deep-blue ointment tube standing upright, with a red-and-white OTC mark at the upper right, vertical Chinese label, a silver crimped tail stamped "202301", and a white screw cap.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] In the warm lamplight of the bedroom <Subject 3>, <Subject 6> stands upright on the inner side of the light-wood bedside table, its white body catching a soft highlight from the warm lamp glow, its deep-blue label and red-and-white OTC mark clearly visible. The camera holds an extreme close-up, slow lateral pan, angled at 45 degrees, at eye level, fixed, sweeping from the left side of the nightstand across to the tube.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to a close shot, front at eye level, fixed. <Subject 1> stands beside the bed, reaching her right hand toward the nightstand to pick up <Subject 6>, her left hand steadying the body. As she twists open the white screw cap, a blinding white light bursts from the tube mouth, flooding her face and the entire frame, swallowing the warm lamplight.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a full shot, low-angle looking up, fixed, as the white light fades. In the center of the bedroom before the bed stands <Subject 5>, the tall guardian with the tube-shaped white helmet, white-blue armor, and short white cape, holding his gel gun in his right hand with the muzzle angled slightly downward, a ring of blue light spreading at his feet. <Subject 1> stands at the left edge of the frame, stepping back slightly, looking up at him. A soft blue-white glow radiates from the guardian while warm lamplight enters from the left. The guardian speaks firmly: <d>[Chinese] 芙美松卫士（坚定）："有我在，别怕。"</d>.
overall_soundscape:
Soft plastic cap-twisting friction, a crisp ringing hum followed by a light burst as the white light flares, low vibration rumble of the blue ring, dense shrill screeching of monsters approaching, quick pattering footsteps, subtle ambient hum of the micro-space.
non_diegetic_music:
Brief shimmering chime at the white light flash, then a heroic low brass swell as the guardian appears, shifting to a tense percussive rhythm as the monsters charge.


## 【封装单元 3/4】
duration: 12
subject_definitions:
画面风格：手绘赛璐璐 · 粗描边 · 平涂色块 · 经典动画质感
<Subject 1> A tall heroic guardian figure (25-30 years old) with a square face, sharp jawline, light wheat-toned skin, wearing a white tube-shaped helmet with a light-blue spiral top and a vertical deep-blue front stripe, white-and-blue armor with a deep-blue diamond core on the chest, a short white cape, holding a compact gel applicator gun. His voice is deep, steady, reassuring, with a firm tone at a moderate pace.
<Subject 2> A red spiky ball-shaped tiny monster (fist-sized, no gender) covered in short red spines with darker red tips, a small round light-orange belly patch, two short feet with three toes, two short arms with three-fingered round pads, large round pitch-black eyes, a wide W-shaped jagged mouth with tiny white fangs, no nose, two dark-red cheek patches, three upright dark-red spines on its head. Its voice is squeaky, shrill, chaotic, tiny, at a fast pace.
<Subject 3> The skin surface micro-world: a vast light-pink skin surface with fine diamond grid texture, several raised red bumps of varying sizes, white flaky skin debris scattered, tiny floating blue light particles in the air, soft blue-white ambient light.
<Subject 4> A gel applicator gun, streamlined sci-fi shape with a white matte body, deep-blue parts, a semi-transparent light-blue gel reservoir tube, a round silver nozzle, and a curved silver trigger.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] the camera cuts to a full shot, low-angle looking up, fixed, inside the microscopic skin-surface world <Subject 3>. A swarm of <Subject 2> red spiky monsters gathers in the distance and charges toward <Subject 1>, who stands on a skin ridge at the right, right hand holding the gel gun, body braced low, facing the oncoming horde. Cool blue-white ambient light spreads evenly, the red of the monsters and raised bumps warming the otherwise cold scene.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, In the microscopic skin-surface world <Subject 3>, <Subject 1> stands firm on the left side of the frame, both hands raising the gel gun <Subject 4> forward, the muzzle aimed at the swarm of <Subject 2> red spiky monsters charging from the right. He pulls the trigger with a determined expression; a mass of blue gel erupts from the nozzle, expanding midair into a huge translucent net that spreads wide and precisely descends over the monster horde, with a blue flash at the muzzle. The guardian declares: <d>[Chinese] 芙美松卫士（举起凝胶枪）："你们该安静了。"</d>.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a close-up, top-down view, fixed. The <Subject 2> red spiky monsters struggle inside the translucent blue gel net, piled on the skin surface of <Subject 3>, their little arms and legs thrashing, their squealing fading. The net tightens gradually, pressing the monsters flat against the diamond-shaped skin texture, their red bodies showing through the blue net. Their movements slow and they calm down.
overall_soundscape:
Trigger click, a soft puff of gel ejection, a wide whoosh as the net unfurls, sticky squelching as the net tightens, squeaky struggling cries fading gradually into near silence, faint breathing and low ambient floor noise.
non_diegetic_music:
A firm, steady brass-and-percussion motif for the guardian's action, then thinning out into a calm, warm ambient pad as the monsters settle.


## 【封装单元 4/4】
duration: 14
subject_definitions:
画面风格：手绘赛璐璐 · 粗描边 · 平涂色块 · 经典动画质感
<Subject 1> The young woman (20-25 years old) with a soft, round face, large dark-brown almond eyes, slender build, black medium-length hair falling to her shoulders with light bangs, wearing a white round-neck cotton short-sleeve top and light-blue cotton shorts, barefoot, stands beside the bed with calm, clear skin. Her voice is soft, relieved, gentle, with a steady tone at a moderate pace.
<Subject 2> A red spiky ball-shaped tiny monster (fist-sized, no gender) covered in short red spines with darker red tips, a small round light-orange belly patch, two short feet with three toes, two short arms with three-fingered round pads, large round pitch-black eyes, a wide W-shaped jagged mouth with tiny white fangs, no nose, two dark-red cheek patches, three upright dark-red spines on its head. Its voice is squeaky, shrill, chaotic, tiny, at a fast pace.
<Subject 3> The bedroom at night: a single bed on the right side of the frame, a light-wood bedside table next to the bed, a window with half-drawn curtains showing a dark blue night sky on the left wall, a white wardrobe on the far wall, a light-gray round rug on the floor, warm yellow lamplight from a bedside lamp, soft dim atmosphere.
<Subject 4> The skin surface micro-world: a vast light-pink skin surface with fine diamond grid texture, smooth and clear with a few faint fading red marks, soft blue-white ambient light.
<Subject 5> A tall heroic guardian figure (25-30 years old) with a square face, sharp jawline, light wheat-toned skin, wearing a white tube-shaped helmet with a light-blue spiral top and a vertical deep-blue front stripe, white-and-blue armor with a deep-blue diamond core on the chest, a short white cape, holding a compact gel applicator gun. His voice is deep, steady, reassuring, with a firm tone at a moderate pace.
detailed_description:
[Shot 1] the camera cuts to an extreme close-up, top-down vertical view, fixed, on the skin surface of <Subject 4>. A red bump in the center of the frame gradually lightens from bright red to pale pink, the raised swelling slowly flattening back to smooth skin. The <Subject 2> monsters curl up quietly inside the net, no longer restless. The blue-white light softens, the skin surface reflects a gentle sheen, and the color tone shifts warmer.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, In the warm lamplight of the bedroom <Subject 3>, <Subject 1> sits on the edge of the bed, leaning slightly forward, looking down at her left forearm, which has returned smooth and calm with the redness and welts faded. She gently strokes the skin with her left hand, and a relieved, reassuring smile spreads across her face. The guardian <Subject 5> stands beside her, lowering the gel gun to his side, and says in a steady, warm tone: <d>[Chinese] 芙美松卫士（收枪，微笑点头）："平复了。"</d>. Nearby, the narrator (S2) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 旁白（SLOGAN）："糠酸莫米松凝胶，平复肌肤小怪兽。"</d> while his/her lips remain completely closed.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up from a top-down angle, fixed, hovering directly above <Subject 1>'s smooth left forearm <Subject 4>. The skin is clear and even, only two faint pale pink spots remaining where the monsters were. A soft blue-white glow settles over the skin surface, the fine diamond grid texture calm and smooth.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a wider medium-close shot from a front angle, eye level, fixed. <Subject 5> tucks the gel applicator gun into his belt, giving <Subject 1> a reassuring nod. <Subject 1> rubs her forearm gently, her expression relaxed and peaceful. The warm lamplight glows softly, the night outside the window calm, the brief scene resting in quiet resolution.
overall_soundscape:
The soft hum of a bedside lamp, faint night breeze outside the window, the gentle rustle of fabric as the woman moves, a light breath of relief, the subtle rustle of cloth as the guardian tucks away the gun.
non_diegetic_music:
A warm, calm, resolved ambient tone with a gentle string section, soft and reassuring, holding a peaceful final note to the end.
